Latest News

Updates from the allotment community

🌿
March 15, 2024

Spring Open Day - A Success!

Over 50 visitors joined us for our spring celebration. We hosted composting demonstrations, a plant swap, and welcomed gardeners of all levels to explore our community. Thanks to all volunteers!

💧
March 8, 2024

New Water System Installed

We've upgraded with automated irrigation and smart timers. The new system reduces water waste by 40% while ensuring consistent watering during dry spells. Thanks to generous local donations!

🦋
February 28, 2024

Wildlife Survey Complete

Spring survey reveals thriving bee populations and even spotted a rare nuthatch! Our diverse plantings are creating perfect habitats for local wildlife. Conservation is thriving here.

This Month's Guide

🌱 Plant Now

Summer vegetables: Courgettes, runner beans, tomatoes. Plant seedlings now for late-summer harvests.

💧 Water Well

Early morning is best: Water at dawn to reduce evaporation and help roots absorb moisture efficiently.

🦋 Support Wildlife

Plant flowers between rows: Sunflowers and calendula attract pollinators and natural pest controllers.
